a.lede: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.
a.title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’

b.lede: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.
b.title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
